synthesis:draft.headline: What TOTALDEMAND is in the DISPATCHREGIONSUM data
summary: TOTALDEMAND appears in the DISPATCHREGIONSUM table and is described as "TOTALDEMAND (NUMBER(15,5)): Demand (less loads)." [mms_dm_elec22#DISPATCHREGIONSUM#0]

AEMO documents give a formulaic composition for TotalDemand: "TotalDemand = Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled and Semi-scheduled generating units – Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled Loads" (the full formula in the source continues with scheduled BDUs, wholesale demand response, net interconnector flow, allocated interconnector losses, DemandForecast and AggregateDispatchError (ADE)). [aemo_demand_terms#p22c46]

TotalDemand is referenced in the Regional Energy Balance used by NEMDE, shown in the dispatch example as part of the equality linking DispatchableGeneration, interconnector targets and Total Demand. [aemo_demand_terms#p31c71]

possible_explanations.statement: TOTALDEMAND may be the region-level demand quantity used in the 5-minute dispatch solution (the DISPATCHREGIONSUM 5-minute solution field) [mms_dm_elec22#DISPATCHREGIONSUM#0].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare DISPATCHREGIONSUM.TOTALDEMAND time series with the NEMDE 5-minute dispatch outputs for the same intervals and confirm the field matches the dispatched demand quantity in published dispatch runs.

possible_explanations.statement: TOTALDEMAND might be calculated by aggregating scheduled and semi-scheduled generation and loads plus BDUs, wholesale demand response, interconnector flows, allocated interconnector losses, DemandForecast and AggregateDispatchError (ADE) as shown in the formula [aemo_demand_terms#p22c46].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the component-level EMMS fields for a sample interval and verify that summing the listed components reproduces the DISPATCHREGIONSUM.TOTALDEMAND reported for that interval.

possible_explanations.statement: TotalDemand could differ from other operational demand measures reported elsewhere (for example, the Regional Energy Balance example shows Total Demand alongside DispatchableGeneration and interconnector targets) [aemo_demand_terms#p31c71].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare DISPATCHREGIONSUM.TOTALDEMAND with operational demand series (e.g., dispatched load, actual metered demand) for the same intervals to quantify differences and confirm field definitions.
